subject.title: fix(memory-core): recover primary embedding provider after fallback latch (#96534)

question: Should this external PR require redacted real Gateway memory_search outage/recovery proof after the latency fix, or should deterministic MemoryIndexManager mock-boundary proof be accepted by maintainer override?
rationale: The contributor has provided useful regression tests but no real setup proof, and repository policy treats real behavior proof as a merge gate for external runtime PRs unless a maintainer explicitly overrides it.

options.title: Require live recovery proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal logs or a linked artifact showing Gateway memory_search fallback during a primary outage, primary recovery, and a successful after-recovery search after the request-path latency fix.

options.title: Override proof after code fix
options.body: A maintainer may accept the deterministic manager-level test as sufficient, but should do so explicitly because it waives the normal external-PR real behavior proof gate.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal logs or a linked artifact showing Gateway memory_search fallback during a primary outage, primary recovery, and a successful after-recovery search after the request-path latency fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on memory provider-state refactors and is the best available owner for a proof-sufficiency call in this area.
